comments.author: github-actions
comments.body:
agentic-code-reviewers v0.4.0 (cursor-sdk)

⚠️ **WARNING:** *(Ocorrência similar identificada)*

This PR extends the retirement registry with `patterns`, `_comment_patterns`, `backend.md.template`, and `frontend.md.template`, but `STALE_LIVE_REFERENCE_PATTERNS` was not updated. Older retired artifacts (`sessionLeases`, `enableAuditing`, `session-lease.schema.json`, `ws-patterns`) all have matching stale-reference patterns, and `test/test-consumer-migration.js` relies on that array to fail CI when live skill or hub bodies reintroduce retired ids. Without parallel entries for the newly retired keys and template filenames, a future edit can add `defaults.patterns` or `backend.md.template` back into SKILL.md, setup.md, or hub docs and slip through the forbidden-id scan even though install/update pruning and ws-doctor stale detection would still treat them as retired.

**Correção sugerida:**

```javascript
const STALE_LIVE_REFERENCE_PATTERNS = [
  { id: 'session_lease.cjs', re: /session_lease\.cjs/i, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'defaults.sessionLeases', re: /\bsessionLeases\b/, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'session-lease.schema.json', re: /session-lease\.schema\.json/i, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'git-lock (lease)', re: /session_lease\.cjs\s+git-lock|\bgit-lock\b.*session/i, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'ws-audit', re: /\bws-audit\b/, removedIn: '0.3.37' },
  { id: 'defaults.enableAuditing', re: /\benableAuditing\b/, removedIn: '0.3.37' },
  { id: 'ws-patterns skill', re: /\bws-patterns(?:-backend|-frontend)?\b/, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'defaults.patternsBackend', re: /\bpatternsBackend\b/, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'defaults.patternsFrontend', re: /\bpatternsFrontend\b/, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'defaults.patterns', re: /\bpatterns\b(?=\s*[:])|\bdefaults\.patterns\b/, removedIn: '0.3.45' },
  { id: 'backend.md.template', re: /backend\.md\.template/i, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'frontend.md.template', re: /frontend\.md\.template/i, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
];
```

<details>
<summary>🔍 Detalhes da Análise IA</summary>

**Score:** 6/10 | **Ação dev:** fix-code

**Análise:**
1. Evidence: Read `retired_artifacts.cjs` — `RETIRED_HUB_FILES` now includes `backend.md.template` and `frontend.md.template` (lines 11–15); `RETIRED_DEFAULTS_KEYS` / `RETIRED_DEFAULTS_COMMENT_KEYS` now include `patterns` / `_comment_patterns` (lines 24–37); `STALE_LIVE_REFERENCE_PATTERNS` (lines 41–49) still ends at the `ws-patterns` entry with no patterns-key or template patterns. Read `test/test-consumer-migration.js` lines 107–139 — the harness scan iterates only `STALE_LIVE_REFERENCE_PATTERNS`, not the full retired key lists. 2. Scenario: A follow-up PR re-adds `defaults.patternsBackend: true` guidance or a `backend.md.template` seed path to `ws-shared/setup.md` or an orch SKILL.md; `npm test` / consumer-migration scan passes because those strings are absent from `STALE_LIVE_REFERENCE_PATTERNS`, while stale consumers still depend on prune/doctor cleanup added here. 3. Protection: New tests in this PR cover prune/doctor/install paths for the added artifacts, but they do not scan live shipped skill bodies for reintroduction — that guard is exclusively the stale-pattern loop. No test asserts parity between retirement lists and `STALE_LIVE_REFERENCE_PATTERNS`. 4. Discards: Considered reporting `hub.gitignore` `!backend.md.template` exceptions — file is outside the eligible diff and does not break install (templates are already absent from `HUB_WHITELIST`). Considered functional prune bugs — `pruneRetiredConsumerArtifacts`, doctor fallback, and extended install/doctor tests are consistent. Considered `backend.md` / `frontend.md` intro prose — updates correctly mark files as optional local notes in en-us.

**Caminhos analisados:** .agents/skills/ws-shared/scripts/retired_artifacts.cjs, test/test-consumer-migration.js, .agents/skills/ws-doctor/scripts/doctor.js
</details>

comments.author: github-actions
comments.body:
agentic-code-reviewers v0.4.0 (cursor-sdk)

⚠️ **WARNING:** *(Ocorrência similar identificada)*

This PR extends `RETIRED_HUB_FILES` and the retired defaults key lists for `patterns` / `_comment_patterns` / pattern templates (issue #250 AC1–AC2), but `STALE_LIVE_REFERENCE_PATTERNS` was not expanded to match. Issue #250 AC3 requires live-reference patterns for `patternsBackend`, `patternsFrontend`, and `_comment_patterns*` (plus the newly retired template filenames). The harness scan in `test/test-consumer-migration.js` only iterates `STALE_LIVE_REFERENCE_PATTERNS`; without new entries, a future skill edit that reintroduces `defaults.patternsBackend` or `_comment_patterns` prose will not fail CI even though install/update would still strip those keys/files.

**Correção sugerida:**

```javascript
const STALE_LIVE_REFERENCE_PATTERNS = [
  { id: 'session_lease.cjs', re: /session_lease\.cjs/i, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'defaults.sessionLeases', re: /\bsessionLeases\b/, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'session-lease.schema.json', re: /session-lease\.schema\.json/i, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'git-lock (lease)', re: /session_lease\.cjs\s+git-lock|\bgit-lock\b.*session/i, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'ws-audit', re: /\bws-audit\b/, removedIn: '0.3.37' },
  { id: 'defaults.enableAuditing', re: /\benableAuditing\b/, removedIn: '0.3.37' },
  { id: 'ws-patterns skill', re: /\bws-patterns(?:-backend|-frontend)?\b/, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'defaults.patternsBackend', re: /\bpatternsBackend\b/, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'defaults.patternsFrontend', re: /\bpatternsFrontend\b/, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'defaults.patterns', re: /\bdefaults\.patterns\b|"patterns"\s*:/, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: '_comment_patterns', re: /_comment_patterns(?:Backend|Frontend)?\b/, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'backend.md.template', re: /backend\.md\.template/i, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
  { id: 'frontend.md.template', re: /frontend\.md\.template/i, removedIn: '0.3.38' },
];
```

<details>
<summary>🔍 Detalhes da Análise IA</summary>

**Score:** 7/10 | **Ação dev:** fix-code

**Análise:**
1. Evidence: Read `retired_artifacts.cjs` L11–37 (new retired hub files and keys) vs L41–48 (`STALE_LIVE_REFERENCE_PATTERNS` still only covers session leases, ws-audit, enableAuditing, and ws-patterns). Issue spec `.agents/specs/us-250.spec.md` AC3 explicitly lists `patternsBackend`, `patternsFrontend`, and `_comment_patterns*`. `test/test-consumer-migration.js` L107–139 scans skills using only `STALE_LIVE_REFERENCE_PATTERNS`. 2. Scenario: A follow-up PR adds dispatch prose referencing `defaults.patternsBackend` in `ws-spec-to-pr/PROTOCOLS.md`; migration tests stay green, consumers get config keys stripped on update but live shipped skills reintroduce retired guidance until manually caught. 3. Protection: Current tree has zero live skill matches (grep across `.agents/skills` for `patternsBackend|patternsFrontend|_comment_patterns` hits only `retired_artifacts.cjs`, `doctor.js` fallback, tests, and specs), so the scan passes today without covering the new retirement surface. 4. Discards: Treating the existing `ws-patterns` regex as sufficient — it does not match `patternsBackend`, `patternsFrontend`, or `_comment_patterns`. Adding bare `\bpatterns\b` — would false-positive on unrelated prose such as config schema “test-surface patterns”.

**Caminhos analisados:** /.agents/skills/ws-shared/scripts/retired_artifacts.cjs, /test/test-consumer-migration.js, /.agents/specs/us-250.spec.md, /.agents/skills/ws-doctor/scripts/doctor.js
</details>
